column3: NKJV has the present “I speak,” following the Textus Receptus; the critical text has the perfect “I have spoken.”
NKJV has “My Father,” following the Textus Receptus; the critical text reads “the Father.”
NKJV has “the Christ, the Son of the living God,” following the Textus Receptus; the critical text reads “the Holy One of God.”
NKJV has “Judas Iscariot, the son of Simon,” following the Textus Receptus; the critical text reads “Judas son of Simon Iscariot.”
